name: aum-estates
description: Production website and secure data pipeline for AUM ESTATES Gurgaon (Est. 2002)

scripts.serve: node -e 'const http = require("http"), fs = require("fs"), path = require("path"); const base = path.resolve("aum-grid-local-baseline-2026-10-27/dist"); const mimes = {".html":"text/html",".css":"text/css",".js":"application/javascript",".json":"application/json",".jpg":"image/jpeg",".jpeg":"image/jpeg",".png":"image/png",".webp":"image/webp",".svg":"image/svg+xml"}; http.createServer((req,res) => { let p = path.join(base, req.url.split("?")[0]); if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) p = path.join(p, "index.html"); if (!fs.existsSync(p)) { res.writeHead(404); res.end("Not found"); return; } res.writeHead(200, {"Content-Type": mimes[path.extname(p)] || "application/octet-stream"}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }).listen(8000, () => console.log("\nAUM ESTATES preview running at: http://localhost:8000/\n"));'
scripts.serve:hostinger: node -e 'const http = require("http"), fs = require("fs"), path = require("path"); const base = path.resolve("AUM_ESTATES_Website_For_Hostinger"); const mimes = {".html":"text/html",".css":"text/css",".js":"application/javascript",".json":"application/json",".jpg":"image/jpeg",".jpeg":"image/jpeg",".png":"image/png",".webp":"image/webp",".svg":"image/svg+xml"}; http.createServer((req,res) => { let p = path.join(base, req.url.split("?")[0]); if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) p = path.join(p, "index.html"); if (!fs.existsSync(p)) { res.writeHead(404); res.end("Not found"); return; } res.writeHead(200, {"Content-Type": mimes[path.extname(p)] || "application/octet-stream"}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }).listen(8080, () => console.log("\nAUM ESTATES Hostinger tree preview running at: http://localhost:8080/\n"));'
